title: Cross-Cloud Caching for External Connections
summary: BigQuery connections to AWS, Azure, and Salesforce Data Cloud now support an optional cross-cloud caching feature. This can improve query performance and reduce network egress costs for external data sources.
details: A new `crossCloudCacheOptions` property has been added to `AwsProperties`, `AzureProperties`, and `SalesforceDataCloudProperties` schemas. This property references a new `CrossCloudCacheOptions` schema, which contains an `enabled` boolean field. Setting `enabled` to `true` will store read data and metadata in a cache, optimizing performance and reducing egress costs for cross-cloud queries through BigQuery.
